executive_summary: Episode 13 advances the Bride of Charlie investigation around Tyler Robinson, presenting a purported 6:38 p.m. Dairy Queen photo, the doorbell-cam footage released via TMZ, witness statements from Sherry Steel (BBC) and the Steel family children (Good Morning America), Netanyahu's second denial video, the PBD Eric Bowling clip, Bill Aman's text messages, the pre-event Amazon book, and a Utah artist's 'Charlie Kirk Dead at 31' song. The episode juxtaposes official-fed timeline claims against host-asserted inconsistencies and pushes the local 'vacant house / decoy' theory. Netanyahu's statement is read in full and reframed as Jewish/Christian identity politics. No new physical evidence is shown for the text-message wording claims.

claims.label: Photo of Robinson at Dairy Queen at 6:38 p.m.
claims.claim: A photograph allegedly showing Tyler Robinson at a Dairy Queen roughly 15–17 minutes from UVU was circulated by locals and depicts him wearing jeans and a maroon shirt.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original file with EXIF; cross-check Dairy Queen receipts, employee testimony, and surveillance video for the vehicle.
claims.transcript_snippet: a very clear image of Tyler Robinson allegedly taken… allegedly taken at 6:38 p.m. at a nearby Dairy Queen.

claims.label: Robinson texts use word 'outfit'
claims.claim: The text exchange between Tyler Robinson and 'Lance' contains the word 'outfits', which the host argues is gender-marked language atypical of a male shooter.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original text-message screenshots from the federal exhibit to verify wording and authorship.
claims.transcript_snippet: He says to Lance, allegedly, quote, 'I worry about Prince. I had to leave it… changed outfits.'
claims.uncertainty_note: Artifact verbally referenced but not shown on screen; requires human verification against the federal exhibit.

claims.label: Robinson texts use phrase 'squad car'
claims.claim: The text exchange between Tyler Robinson and 'Lance' describes seeing a 'squad car' near the rifle, which the host argues is insider language.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check the original text-message screenshots from the federal exhibit.
claims.transcript_snippet: I can get close to it, but there is a squad car parked right by it. Squad car.
claims.uncertainty_note: Artifact verbally referenced but not shown on screen.

claims.label: Doorbell-cam footage aired by TMZ on September 10
claims.claim: TMZ first aired doorbell-camera footage of a person running on a residential street near UVU on September 10, 2025, attributed to Irwin Steel's home.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify TMZ publication timestamp; trace the footage upload chain back to either the homeowner or a federal intermediary.
claims.transcript_snippet: TMZ is the first on September 10th. That tells us that there is doorbell cam footage.

claims.label: Sherry Steel reported police presence to BBC
claims.claim: BBC published an account by Sherry Steel describing a large police presence and helicopter activity outside Tyler Robinson's townhouse while she walked her dog in the evening.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Sherry Steel exists in property / building databases; obtain her withheld video from BBC.
claims.transcript_snippet: Sherry Steel, who lives across the street… came back from an evening walk to see a large police presence.

claims.label: Steel children described Kirk shooting on GMA
claims.claim: Tiffany Barker and her nieces L Steel and Mia Grant stated on Good Morning America that they were roughly 15 feet from Charlie Kirk when he was shot and described a family group of 16.
claims.investigative_direction: Corroborate the family's UVU attendance, family-of-16 size, and relationship to one another.
claims.transcript_snippet: We had 16 of us there. So, five adults and like 11 children.

claims.label: Netanyahu released second video denying Israeli involvement
claims.claim: Benjamin Netanyahu issued a second video statement denying that Israel had any role in Charlie Kirk's murder and quoted from a letter he attributes to Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Netanyahu's first denial video and the unedited Kirk letter; verify date stamps on both.
claims.transcript_snippet: somebody has fabricated a monstrous big lie that Israel had something to do with Charlie Kirk's horrific murder. This is insane.

claims.label: Local claim: gun found near chicken coop, not 'woods'
claims.claim: A local source told the host that the rifle was recovered by a chicken coop in a suburban backyard, not in a wooded area as federal accounts suggest.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check federal affidavit language re 'woods'; obtain property records for the chicken-coop site.

claims.uncertainty_note: Single anonymous local source relayed by host.

claims.label: Local theory: vacant UVU-owned house is real shooter refuge
claims.claim: Locals theorise that a vacant house next door to the gun-recovery site is owned by Utah Valley University and served as the real shooter's safe house, with Robinson acting as a decoy.

claims.label: Sherry Steel cannot be verified in building databases
claims.claim: The host's team searched local databases for a 'Sherry Steel' at the apartment complex and contacted Robinson's family; no matching resident was located.

claims.label: Owens toured with TPUSA the previous year
claims.claim: Candace Owens states that she went on tour with Turning Point USA on college campuses the previous year, contradicting Bowling's claim that she has not spoken at TPUSA events.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull TPUSA published tour schedules and verify Owens speaking appearances.
claims.transcript_snippet: I literally went on tour with Turning Point USA on college campuses last year.

claims.label: Owens was not invited to speak at Kirk memorial
claims.claim: Candace Owens states she was not invited to speak at the Kirk memorial event held in Arizona, and that the event was effectively an open memorial.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify published speaker list for the Arizona memorial event.
claims.transcript_snippet: I was not invited to speak alongside President Trump and JD Vance on the stage.

claims.label: Feds pressured locals not to release footage
claims.claim: Locals emailed the host stating that any footage they possessed was sent to federal authorities who then pressured them not to release it publicly.
claims.investigative_direction: FOIA requests to federal agencies; canvass Orem residents for corroboration.
claims.transcript_snippet: the feds told them that they were not allowed to share it at all.

claims.label: Steele family owns the doorbell-camera house
claims.claim: Property records show that the house whose footage appeared on TMZ is owned by Samuel Steele, his wife Carrie, and Irwin Steel — not Irwin Steel alone.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull county recorder data for the parcel to confirm ownership chain.
claims.transcript_snippet: he Samuel and his wife Carrie are the ones that own the house that gave the footage, not Irwin.

claims.label: Bowling described 'quiet breakup' between Kirk and Owens
claims.claim: Eric Bowling on PBD Podcast stated that Candace Owens would have been 'the logical heir to the TPUSA throne' absent a 'very quiet breakup where she got too rabbit hole for him'.
